rules: The harbour gate closes at sunset.
In the storm no boat leaves the harbour.

locations.name: Harbour
locations.description: Stone quays, the harbour master's hut, a storm coming in from the west.

locations.name: The Gull Inn
locations.description: A low taproom with a fire and three rooms upstairs.

locations.name: Lighthouse
locations.description: A white tower on the breakwater; the lamp room is reached by ninety steps.

locations.name: Seamen's Chapel
locations.description: A cold chapel with the names of the drowned on its walls.

locations.name: Bonded Warehouse
locations.description: Customs storage behind a locked door; tonight's crates wait inside.

characters.name: Mara
characters.public: The harbour master: fifty, curt, respected.
goals: Keep tonight's shipment off the books

secrets.text: She took a bribe from the smuggler. [SECRET-MARA-7Q]

characters.name: Silas
characters.public: A trader from the south, stranded at the inn by the storm.
goals: Get the crates aboard before dawn

secrets.text: The crates hold rifles, not wine. [SECRET-SILAS-3K]

characters.name: Ines
characters.public: The lighthouse keeper, young and new to the town.
goals: Find out why the harbour master lied to her

secrets.text: She was paid to dim the lamp at midnight. [SECRET-INES-9D]

arc.premise: A storm traps three people in a harbour town overnight.

chapters.goal: The shipment's secret reaches the wrong person.
